promise: Setup Check finds an installed `hangar` however the app was opened, and only offers to install where a shell would look.
why: An app opened from Finder inherits launchd's PATH, which holds none of the directories the tool goes in. The check walked that PATH, so it said not installed next to a link the user had just made with the command it handed them.
command: scripts/test.sh --filter CommandLineStateTests 2>&1 | grep -qE 'Executed [1-9][0-9]* tests, with 0 failures'
